ComparisonItem.title: ComparisonItem
ComparisonItem.description: A report run's comparison step, which computes the report's result.

CountryItem.title: CountryItem
CountryItem.description:
One served country and the calculations it supports.

``id`` is the value other v2 resources take as ``country_id``.
``household_enabled`` means household calculations and saved households
are available; ``society_wide_enabled`` means society-wide reports are,
and is only set for a country that is also household enabled.

CountryListResponse.title: CountryListResponse
CountryListResponse.description: Success envelope: ``status`` "ok", a null ``message`` and the countries.

EconomyReportCreateRequest.title: EconomyReportCreateRequest
EconomyReportCreateRequest.description:
A new economy report; ``country_id`` must match the query's.

``baseline`` and ``reform`` each name a v2 policy and dynamic, and an
empty object means current law. Options are not accepted yet.

EconomyReportRunRequest.title: EconomyReportRunRequest
EconomyReportRunRequest.description:
A re-run of an economy or household report on the current catalog version.

``{}`` reuses existing runs: an economy report's simulation runs for that
version and year, or a household report's calculations that are
unfinished or succeeded within the last 28 days. With ``force``, each of
the report's simulations (one for a household report of the baseline
alone) is calculated again as a new attempt.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Health-check result showing that the API is up and serving requests.

HouseholdCalculationAxis.title: HouseholdCalculationAxis
HouseholdCalculationAxis.description:
One input varied across points.

The variable ``name`` takes ``count`` evenly spaced values from ``min`` to
``max`` in ``period`` (the household's ``default_year`` when omitted), for
the entity member at position ``index`` (the first when omitted).

HouseholdCalculationError.title: HouseholdCalculationError
HouseholdCalculationError.description: Why a calculation failed; ``detail`` holds the calculation's own error.

HouseholdCalculationItem.title: HouseholdCalculationItem
HouseholdCalculationItem.description:
A household calculation and its outcome.

``status`` moves from ``pending`` through ``dispatching`` and ``running``
to ``succeeded``, with ``result``, or ``failed``, with ``error``. Poll
``GET /v2/household-calculations/{calculation_id}`` until it is one of
those two. ``catalog_version_id`` is the catalog version calculated.

HouseholdCalculationOutput.title: HouseholdCalculationOutput
HouseholdCalculationOutput.description:
A succeeded calculation's household.

``household`` is the stored household in the situation shape (people and
groups keyed by their record IDs) with each calculated value filled in by
period. ``warnings`` lists inputs the country model ignored. In the US,
``spm_config`` is the SPM selection the calculation applied and
``spm_provenance`` its receipt; both are null elsewhere.
``policyengine_version`` is the PolicyEngine.py version that calculated it.

HouseholdCalculationRequest.title: HouseholdCalculationRequest
HouseholdCalculationRequest.description:
A stored household to calculate under a stored policy, or current law.

``household_id`` and ``policy_id`` name records of ``country_id`` stored
through ``/v2/households`` and ``/v2/policies``; without ``policy_id`` the
household is calculated under current law, for the household's
``default_year``. Each group in ``axes`` varies its inputs together across
``count`` points; several groups form a grid of at most 10,000 points.
``add_missing_variables`` adds every variable the household lacks before
calculating. An identical calculation that succeeded in the last 28 days
is returned again instead of being repeated.

HouseholdCalculationResponse.title: HouseholdCalculationResponse
HouseholdCalculationResponse.description: Success envelope: ``status`` "ok", a null ``message`` and the calculation.

default_year.title: Default Year
default_year.description: Default year for values without explicit period keys

HouseholdCreateRequest.title: HouseholdCreateRequest
HouseholdCreateRequest.description: Native immutable household content with no presentation or model fields.

HouseholdEntityRecord.title: HouseholdEntityRecord
HouseholdEntityRecord.description:
One group entity in a household, such as a tax unit or a benefit unit.

``id`` is unique within its collection and is what people's ``memberships``
refer to. ``values`` maps variable names to values, and ``source_name``
optionally keeps the entity's original name, such as its key in a v1 household.

anyOf.description: Default year for values without explicit period keys

HouseholdItem.title: HouseholdItem
HouseholdItem.description:
A stored household.

Households are immutable and deduplicated: creating one with identical
content returns the existing household and its ``id``.

HouseholdPageResponse.title: HouseholdPageResponse
HouseholdPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of households.

HouseholdPageResult.title: HouseholdPageResult
HouseholdPageResult.description:
One page of households, oldest first.

``offset`` and ``limit`` echo the request; when ``has_more`` is true, ask
for the next page with ``offset + limit``.

HouseholdPersonRecord.title: HouseholdPersonRecord
HouseholdPersonRecord.description:
One person in a household.

``memberships`` maps each of the country's entity collections to the ``id``
of the group the person belongs to, and must name every collection.

HouseholdPolicyChoice.title: HouseholdPolicyChoice
HouseholdPolicyChoice.description: A stored v2 policy of the report's country, or none for current law.

HouseholdReportCalculationErrorItem.title: HouseholdReportCalculationErrorItem
HouseholdReportCalculationErrorItem.description:
Why a household calculation failed.

``code`` is ``household_calculation_failed`` when the household function
refused the inputs, with its error in ``detail``; ``worker_error``,
``worker_timeout`` or ``dispatch_abandoned`` otherwise.

HouseholdReportCalculationItem.title: HouseholdReportCalculationItem
HouseholdReportCalculationItem.description:
One calculation of the household under one policy (a simulation run).

A null ``policy_id`` means current law. ``status`` is ``pending``,
``dispatching``, ``running``, ``succeeded`` or ``failed``; ``attempt``
counts forced recalculations. ``result`` is set once it succeeded and
``error`` once it failed.

HouseholdReportCalculationResultItem.title: HouseholdReportCalculationResultItem
HouseholdReportCalculationResultItem.description:
The household with each requested value filled in, in its own key order.

``spm_config`` is the SPM selection applied and ``spm_provenance`` its
receipt, both null for a country without SPM.

HouseholdReportCreateRequest.title: HouseholdReportCreateRequest
HouseholdReportCreateRequest.description:
A new household report; ``country_id`` must match the query's.

``baseline`` and ``reform`` each name a v2 policy of the country, and an
empty object means current law; ``reform`` is null for a report of the
baseline alone. It is calculated for the household's ``default_year``;
with ``add_missing_variables``, each calculation also adds every yearly,
monthly and eternal variable the household lacks, as ``/calculate-full``
does. A re-run keeps the choice made when the report was created.

HouseholdReportItem.title: HouseholdReportItem
HouseholdReportItem.description: A household report with its newest run and that run's calculations.

HouseholdReportRunItem.title: HouseholdReportRunItem
HouseholdReportRunItem.description:
One calculation of a household report: the baseline's and the reform's.

``reform`` is null for a report of the baseline alone.

HouseholdReportRunSummaryItem.title: HouseholdReportRunSummaryItem
HouseholdReportRunSummaryItem.description:
One calculation of a household report, without its calculations.

``trigger`` is ``initial`` for the run a submission starts and ``manual``
for a re-run. ``tax_benefit_model_version_id`` and ``policyengine_version``
name the catalog version it ran on.

HouseholdReportSummaryItem.title: HouseholdReportSummaryItem
HouseholdReportSummaryItem.description:
A household report: a stored household under a baseline and a reform.

The report is for the household's ``default_year``. ``status`` is the
newest run's, or ``not_run`` before the first run, when ``household_id`` is
not known either. ``reform_simulation_id`` is null for a report of the
baseline alone.

MeDetailResponse.title: MeDetailResponse
MeDetailResponse.description: Success response holding the current user.

MeDetailResult.title: MeDetailResult
MeDetailResult.description: Result holding the current user in ``item``.

MeExportResponse.title: MeExportResponse
MeExportResponse.description: Success response holding the current user's export.

MeExportResult.title: MeExportResult
MeExportResult.description:
The current user and every policy, household, simulation and report it saved.

The export covers every country, not only the requested one.

MeItem.title: MeItem
MeItem.description:
The current user: a signed-in account or a browser's unauthenticated user.

``user_type`` says which. An unauthenticated user has no primary country, and
only a signed-in user can set its names or primary country.

MeUpgradeResponse.title: MeUpgradeResponse
MeUpgradeResponse.description: Success response holding the signed-in account after an upgrade.

MeUpgradeResult.title: MeUpgradeResult
MeUpgradeResult.description:
The signed-in account after a browser's unauthenticated user moved into it.

``outcome`` is ``converted`` when the unauthenticated user became the account
in place, ``merged`` when its records moved to an existing account, and
``none`` when there was no unauthenticated user to move.

MetadataCanonicalParameterValue.title: MetadataCanonicalParameterValue
MetadataCanonicalParameterValue.description:
One current-law value of a parameter.

The value applies from start_date until end_date, or indefinitely when
end_date is null.

MetadataCatalogParameter.title: MetadataCatalogParameter
MetadataCatalogParameter.description: A parameter with its current-law values in start-date order.

MetadataCatalogParametersResponse.title: MetadataCatalogParametersResponse
MetadataCatalogParametersResponse.description: Success response holding parameters fetched by name, with their values.

MetadataCatalogParametersResult.title: MetadataCatalogParametersResult
MetadataCatalogParametersResult.description:
Requested parameters of one catalog version, in name order.

node_labels maps each ancestor of a requested parameter that the version
stores as a parameter node to the node's stored label (null when it has
none), for breadcrumbs; a bracket index such as ``rates[0]`` counts as a
child of its schedule ``rates``. missing_names lists requested names the
version has no parameter for.

MetadataCatalogVariablesResponse.title: MetadataCatalogVariablesResponse
MetadataCatalogVariablesResponse.description: Success response holding every variable of one catalog version.

MetadataCatalogVariablesResult.title: MetadataCatalogVariablesResult
MetadataCatalogVariablesResult.description:
Every variable of one catalog version, in name order.

part_parameter_values has an entry for each parameter path a variable's
adds_parameter_path or subtracts_parameter_path names: that parameter's
current-law values in start-date order, or an empty list when the
catalog has no such parameter.

MetadataDataset.title: MetadataDataset
MetadataDataset.description:
A named input dataset available to the selected model version.

These datasets are logical inputs, so storage_path is always null and
is_output_dataset is always false.

MetadataDatasetOption.title: MetadataDatasetOption
MetadataDatasetOption.description: The national dataset, offered as the default for an economy calculation.

MetadataDatasetPageResponse.title: MetadataDatasetPageResponse
MetadataDatasetPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of datasets.

MetadataDatedValue.title: MetadataDatedValue
MetadataDatedValue.description:
A current-law parameter value from start_date until end_date.

A null end_date means the value applies until a later value starts, or
indefinitely.

MetadataEconomyOptions.title: MetadataEconomyOptions
MetadataEconomyOptions.description:
The region, year and dataset choices for an economy calculation.

Every list is empty for a catalog without regions, such as a
household-only country's, which offers no economy calculation.

MetadataEconomyOptionsResponse.title: MetadataEconomyOptionsResponse
MetadataEconomyOptionsResponse.description: Success response holding the options for configuring an economy comparison.

MetadataEconomyOptionsResult.title: MetadataEconomyOptionsResult
MetadataEconomyOptionsResult.description:
The choices for configuring an economy calculation.

It lists the selectable regions, years and datasets, and the id of the
current-law policy to use as a baseline.

MetadataEntity.title: MetadataEntity
MetadataEntity.description:
A kind of member a household holds, such as a person or a tax unit.

plural is the key the household's members of this kind are listed under,
and is_person marks the entity every household input about a person uses.

MetadataEnumValue.title: MetadataEnumValue
MetadataEnumValue.description:
One value of an enum variable: its stored name and its display label.

The label keeps the type the country package declares it with.

MetadataModel.title: MetadataModel
MetadataModel.description: A country's tax-benefit model in the selected PolicyEngine.py catalog.

MetadataModelCatalogResponse.title: MetadataModelCatalogResponse
MetadataModelCatalogResponse.description: Success response holding the small parts of one catalog version.

MetadataModelCatalogResult.title: MetadataModelCatalogResult
MetadataModelCatalogResult.description:
The small parts of one catalog version, read when a client starts.

policyengine_version names the selected catalog version, so a client can
request its other parts for that exact version. catalog_format is null,
and entities and basic_inputs are empty, for a version published before
catalog format 2. ``spm`` says whether the version offers SPM settings.
Variables, parameters and their values are served by their own routes.

MetadataModelDetailResponse.title: MetadataModelDetailResponse
MetadataModelDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one tax-benefit model.

MetadataModelPageResponse.title: MetadataModelPageResponse
MetadataModelPageResponse.description:
Success response holding a page of the selected catalog's tax-benefit models.

A catalog has one model per country, so only the first page has an item.

MetadataModelSelectionResponse.title: MetadataModelSelectionResponse
MetadataModelSelectionResponse.description: Success response holding a country's model and its selected model version.

MetadataModelSelectionResult.title: MetadataModelSelectionResult
MetadataModelSelectionResult.description: A country's model together with the model version selected for the request.

MetadataModelVersionDetail.title: MetadataModelVersionDetail
MetadataModelVersionDetail.description: A model version, with its current-law policy id and the years offered.

MetadataModelVersionDetailResponse.title: MetadataModelVersionDetailResponse
MetadataModelVersionDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one model version.

MetadataModelVersionPageResponse.title: MetadataModelVersionPageResponse
MetadataModelVersionPageResponse.description:
Success response holding a page of the selected catalog's model versions.

A catalog has one model version, so only the first page has an item.

MetadataParameterChild.title: MetadataParameterChild
MetadataParameterChild.description:
A direct child in the parameter tree.

A node has a child_count; a parameter leaf carries the parameter's summary.

MetadataParameterChildPageResponse.title: MetadataParameterChildPageResponse
MetadataParameterChildPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of a parameter path's direct children.

MetadataParameterPageResponse.title: MetadataParameterPageResponse
MetadataParameterPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of parameters.

MetadataParameterSearchFileContent.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileContent
MetadataParameterSearchFileContent.description:
One catalog version's parameter search file, ordered by path.

It holds what v3's parameter search reads, without the catalog's values.
A reader applies v1's label fallback where a label is null.

MetadataParameterSearchFileEditabilityCh.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileEditabilityChange
MetadataParameterSearchFileEditabilityCh.description: From ``start_date`` (an ISO date), whether a draft can edit the value.

MetadataParameterSearchFileLabel.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileLabel
MetadataParameterSearchFileLabel.description: Another parameter under ``gov``: its path and stored label, or null.

MetadataParameterSearchFileNode.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileNode
MetadataParameterSearchFileNode.description: ``gov`` or a node under it that has a stored label.

MetadataParameterSearchFileParameter.title: MetadataParameterSearchFileParameter
MetadataParameterSearchFileParameter.description:
A parameter a reform can change, with what v3's search indexes.

``label`` is the stored label, or null when none is stored. ``editable``
says whether a draft can edit the earliest current-law value (a number, a
yes/no value or an infinite threshold); ``editable_changes``, present only
when that changes over time and never null, lists the dates from which it
changes.

MetadataParameterSummary.title: MetadataParameterSummary
MetadataParameterSummary.description:
A policy parameter, described without its values.

Its current-law values are listed by GET /v2/parameter-values. economy and
household say whether a reform of an economy or of a household may change
it; they are null in versions published before catalog format 2.

MetadataParameterValueDetailResponse.title: MetadataParameterValueDetailResponse
MetadataParameterValueDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one parameter value.

MetadataParameterValuePageResponse.title: MetadataParameterValuePageResponse
MetadataParameterValuePageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of parameter values.

MetadataRegion.title: MetadataRegion
MetadataRegion.description:
A region the model can simulate, such as a country, state or constituency.

When requires_filter is true, filter_strategy says how the region selects
households of its default dataset. With "row_filter", it keeps the
households whose filter_field column equals filter_value (or is in it,
when filter_value is a JSON list).

MetadataRegionOption.title: MetadataRegionOption
MetadataRegionOption.description: A region that can be chosen for an economy calculation; name is its code.

MetadataRegionPageResponse.title: MetadataRegionPageResponse
MetadataRegionPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of regions.

MetadataRegionType.title: MetadataRegionType
MetadataRegionType.description: The geographic level of a region.

MetadataSPMAvailability.title: MetadataSPMAvailability
MetadataSPMAvailability.description:
Whether a catalog version offers SPM settings for a household.

When ``available``, ``settings_schema`` is the JSON schema of a
household's ``spm`` selection and ``defaults`` the certified selection
that applies to every field a household leaves out. A version without
them (any country but the US, or a bundle without certified SPM support)
is not available, and both are null.

MetadataTimePeriodOption.title: MetadataTimePeriodOption
MetadataTimePeriodOption.description: A year that can be chosen for an economy calculation.

MetadataVariable.title: MetadataVariable
MetadataVariable.description:
A variable the tax-benefit model computes or accepts as input.

adds and subtracts, when present, list the variables summed into or
subtracted from this one. When the model takes that list from a
parameter, adds_parameter_path or subtracts_parameter_path names the
parameter, whose dated values give the list for each year (adds and
subtracts hold its value on 2025-01-01). unit is the country package's
unit (for example ``currency-USD``) and definition_period the period a
value covers (``year``, ``month`` or ``eternity``). The catalog format 2
fields (is_input_variable, hidden_input, module_name, the two parameter
paths, enum_values, unit and definition_period) are null in versions
published before that format.

MetadataVariablePageResponse.title: MetadataVariablePageResponse
MetadataVariablePageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of variables.

PolicyCreateRequest.title: PolicyCreateRequest
PolicyCreateRequest.description: Native body containing immutable policy content only.

PolicyItem.title: PolicyItem
PolicyItem.description:
A stored policy: parameter values for one tax-benefit model.

Policies are immutable and deduplicated: creating one with identical
content returns the existing policy and its ``id``.

PolicyPageResponse.title: PolicyPageResponse
PolicyPageResponse.description: Success response holding one page of policies.

PolicyPageResult.title: PolicyPageResult
PolicyPageResult.description:
One page of policies, oldest first.

``offset`` and ``limit`` echo the request; when ``has_more`` is true, ask
for the next page with ``offset + limit``.

PolicyParameterValueInput.title: PolicyParameterValueInput
PolicyParameterValueInput.description: One normalized effective value for a catalog parameter UUID.

PolicyParameterValueItem.title: PolicyParameterValueItem
PolicyParameterValueItem.description:
One value a policy sets for a parameter from ``start_date``.

``parameter_name`` is the parameter's path in the model, and a null
``end_date`` means the value has no end.

PolicyProvenance.title: PolicyProvenance
PolicyProvenance.description: Where a v3 reform came from.

PolicyProvenanceItem.title: PolicyProvenanceItem
PolicyProvenanceItem.description:
Stored v3 reform provenance as responses publish it.

It mirrors the contract without the input bounds and ignores unknown keys,
so any stored row serializes.

ReportCalibration.title: ReportCalibration
ReportCalibration.description: Calibration results for one geography, with at most 500 variable matches.

ReportCalibrationItem.title: ReportCalibrationItem
ReportCalibrationItem.description: Calibration results saved with a report, for one geography and data release.

ReportCalibrationMatch.title: ReportCalibrationMatch
ReportCalibrationMatch.description:
Calibration of one variable: how closely its targets are met.

``ring`` is ``primary``, ``mechanism`` or ``downstream``.
``mean_abs_relative_error`` is averaged over the variable's ``target_count``
targets, and ``worst`` is the target with the largest error.

ReportCalibrationMatchItem.title: ReportCalibrationMatchItem
ReportCalibrationMatchItem.description: One variable's calibration match: its targets, mean error and worst target.

ReportCalibrationWorst.title: ReportCalibrationWorst
ReportCalibrationWorst.description: The calibration target a match fits worst, with its source and geography.

ReportCalibrationWorstItem.title: ReportCalibrationWorstItem
ReportCalibrationWorstItem.description: The calibration target that one match fits worst, with its relative error.

ReportDetailResult.title: ReportDetailResult
ReportDetailResult.description: Result holding one report, of either kind, in ``item``.

ReportItem.title: ReportItem
ReportItem.description:
An economy report with its result.

``result`` holds today's economy result format (``SingleYearMacroOutput``)
once the newest run has succeeded, and is null otherwise.

ReportListResult.title: ReportListResult
ReportListResult.description:
The listed reports of both kinds in ``items``, in the order asked.

Economy reports are listed without their results and household reports
without their calculations.

ReportProvision.title: ReportProvision
ReportProvision.description:
One provision of the report's reform: a parameter's baseline and reform values.

``path`` is the parameter path and ``breadcrumb`` its readable label, and
``intervals`` optionally gives a dated schedule. ``growth`` says how a value
set from one year on moves in later years (``fixed``, ``current_law`` or an
index's parameter path); the other ``growth_*`` fields say when it moves and
how grown values round. They are absent for a hand-set schedule.

ReportProvisionInterval.title: ReportProvisionInterval
ReportProvisionInterval.description:
One dated value in a provision's schedule, from ``start_date`` to ``end_date``.

Dates are ``YYYY-MM-DD`` strings and ``value`` is any finite JSON value.
``parameter`` is optional, and is left out of the stored report when unset.

ReportProvisionIntervalItem.title: ReportProvisionIntervalItem
ReportProvisionIntervalItem.description: A provision's value for the dates from ``start_date`` to ``end_date``.

ReportProvisionItem.title: ReportProvisionItem
ReportProvisionItem.description:
One parameter the report's reform changes, with its baseline and reform values.

``intervals`` gives the reform's dated values when they vary over time. The
``growth`` keys, present only when set, say how a value set from one year on
moves in later years and how grown values round.

ReportRunDetailResponse.title: ReportRunDetailResponse
ReportRunDetailResponse.description: Success response holding one report run.

ReportRunDetailResult.title: ReportRunDetailResult
ReportRunDetailResult.description: Result holding one report run, of either kind, in ``item``.

ReportRunItem.title: ReportRunItem
ReportRunItem.description:
One calculation of a report: two simulation runs and their comparison.

``trigger`` is ``initial`` for the run a submission starts, ``manual`` for
a re-run and ``system`` for the run the first read of a report with no run
starts. ``tax_benefit_model_version_id`` and ``policyengine_version`` name
the catalog version it ran on. While it runs, ``stage`` is ``queued``,
``simulating`` or ``outputs``.

ReportRunListResponse.title: ReportRunListResponse
ReportRunListResponse.description: Success response holding a report's runs.

ReportRunListResult.title: ReportRunListResult
ReportRunListResult.description: A report's runs in ``items``, newest first.

ReportScorecard.title: ReportScorecard
ReportScorecard.description: The programs on the report's validation scorecard, at most 200 names.

ReportScorecardItem.title: ReportScorecardItem
ReportScorecardItem.description: The programs on the scorecard saved with a report's validation.

ReportStatus.title: ReportStatus
ReportStatus.description:
Where a report or report run stands; a report's is its newest run's.

A report with no run, such as one migrated from v1, is ``not_run``.

ReportSummaryItem.title: ReportSummaryItem
ReportSummaryItem.description:
An economy report comparing a baseline and a reform simulation.

``status`` is the newest run's, or ``not_run`` for a report with no run.
``legacy_report_id`` is the v1 report output it was migrated from.

ReportValidation.title: ReportValidation
ReportValidation.description:
The validation snapshot saved with a report.

``calibration`` and ``scorecard`` are optional, and the stored snapshot keeps
only the keys supplied.

ReportValidationItem.title: ReportValidationItem
ReportValidationItem.description:
The validation snapshot saved with a report.

It records when the report was matched and with which map model version,
and optionally the calibration results and scorecard.

RunErrorItem.title: RunErrorItem
RunErrorItem.description: Why a run failed, without user data.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD); must satisfy the selected artifact's information date

SPMSelection.title: SPMSelection
SPMSelection.description: Select a forecast scenario and an explicit household SPM geography.

UserReportItem.description:

``report_id`` is the v2 report it shows and ``legacy_report_id`` the v1
report output; a report migrated from v1 has both. ``user_policy_id`` is
the user's saved reform the report was run from, and

current law; each is null when not set or once that reform is deleted.
``budget_window_years`` is null for a report without a budget window.
